trigger: Only after the production service confirms a successful milestone claim.

claim.productionDelay: Wait for confirmed reward grant; do not use a timer as eligibility or success.

stars.origin: Claimed row at 54% width, 50% height; convert to modal local coordinates after scroll/scale.
stars.trajectory: angle = index / count × 2π; dx = cos(angle) × (49 + (index % 3) × 11); dy = sin(angle) × 41 - 18; rotation = index × 37°

progressFill.trigger: Updated authoritative qualifying completion count, not reward claim.

reducedMotion: Instant settled state; no scale bounce, glints or animated fill.
cleanup: Cancel particles and visual callbacks on close; retain service reconciliation independently.
